imagery.vintage: not independently provided by the tile response
imagery.method: Independent Leaflet captures per active base at zoom 19 with Brampton road centerlines overlaid; building, parking, driveway and apron extents estimated against each screenshot scale.

roads.assessment: Road/service-drive centerlines were inspected with imagery and used as modeled spawn references. Centerlines do not verify station gates, apparatus entrances, or legal access.

limits: No official station parcel or building footprint was used.
Imagery-based fit dimensions, rotations and spawn points are estimates, not surveyed measurements.
No apparatus door, gate, or emergency access route was independently verified.
Canonical source coordinates and base IDs remain unchanged.
No road geometry or route constraints were modified.
